description: CUHK-Shenzhen lateral and sightly right-side view of administration in the sunset with large clear glass. The glass reflects the tree.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration in the sunset and there is a row of trees in front of it. There is a large open space in front of the administration building.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration in the sunset. The trees are green. A large school badge is posted on the right side of glass of the second floor of administration.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration is a long but low building viewing from afar.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration, ‘administation building’ on the wall indicates what it is.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration, front view of the administration in the sunset. A modern administrative building featuring a predominantly glass curtain wall facade. The top of the building is adorned with the school badge. The main structure connects to an annex via an elevated skybridge.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration, front view of the administration in the sunset. There is large open square in front of the administration building. In the center of the square, there is a large flower basket. On the first floor of the building on the left side, there is a banner hanging down with Chinese characters that read: "诸位今天是桃李芬芳，不忘明天是家国栋梁."
CUHK-Shenzhen administration, the first floor of the building on the right is a combination of glass and concrete, with glass on the upper part and concrete on the lower part.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration, front view of the administration, the first floor of the building on the left and the first floor of the building on the right are connected by climbable stairs that lead to a garden at a higher elevation, indicating that the administrative building is constructed on a slope.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration, left view of the administration in the sunset. There is a white-lettered, purple banner with the words ’一腔热血，百年大学，千载品牌，万世良心’ hanging on the left glass of the building on the first floor on the right side. Each idiom is arranged vertically.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration slightly far and left view of the administration.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration, lateral and left-side view of the administration. Modern-style building with glass and stone facade, featuring vertical metal decorations on top. Two purple banners with yellow text hang on the building. Lush greenery including trees, shrubs, and red flowers in foreground, with a pedestrian and car visible on the ground. Clear blue sky enhances the clean aesthetic.
CUHK-Shenzhen administration, lateral, far and left-side view of the administration.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a left-sided view. Gray main building with vertical striping and purple-gold banners. Adjacent glass/metal annex building. 2800K warm lighting (main) vs 4000K neutral (annex).

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a front-sided and close view. Contemporary building with metal striping decoration, featuring two purple-gold couplets and illuminated school emblem (top-right). 10-step entrance flanked by 3 light poles (4000K) each side.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a front-sided and close view. Main entrance building with gray facade and vertical metal fins. School emblem and bilingual name plaque above doorway, flanked by 1.2m-wide purple/gold banners. 60% windows emit 3000K warm light.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a front-sided and close view. Modern facade combining glass curtain walls and metal fins. 40% windows emit 3000K light, with illuminated school emblem above main entrance. Central floral installation (Ø1.5m) on 10-step staircase.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a slightly left-sided and close view. Glass-curtain-wall building emitting 3000K warm light, featuring purple-yellow emblem at top and "ADMINISTRATION LANDING" sign (4000K) above entrance.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a more left-sided view. Contemporary facade with alternating glass panels and dark vertical fins. Illuminated emblem (top) and "ADMINISTRATION BUILDING" sign (4000K) at entrance. 30% windows emit 3000K warm light in grid pattern. Pole light (3m, 2700K), Lawn lights (5m spacing).

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a more left-sided view. The height of the trees in the front row is consistent with the height of the first floor. Also the purple and gold emblem is on the top.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from a more left-sided view. Contemporary facade with alternating metal fins and glass panels. 6 newly planted trees (with green supports) Linear flower beds (red blooms, likely petunias) Trimmed hedge (~40cm), 4 wooden benches (5m spacing), 2 Pole lights (4.5m, 4000K).
CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night. The right ending part of the administration. Two-story all-glass building emitting 4000K uniform lighting, 85% interior light transmission.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night. The right ending part of the administration. Twin-building complex: left-traditional with purple banners, right-modern with glass curtain walls. Deep blue sky (~8:30PM). The left banner says”不忘明天是国家栋梁” and the right banner says”诸位今天是桃李芬芳”.

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at daytime. This is the garden of administration. Multi-story building with alternating matte metal panels (18% reflectance) and Low-E glazing (65% VLT). Ryegrass lawn (5cm height). Flush drainage channels. Anti-slip granite (8mm joints).

CUHK-Shenzhen administration at night from right-sided view. This is the right end of the administration. Contemporary facade with light panels and glazing. Left glass section reveals 3000K-lit interior staircase; right wall displays two purple vertical banners (~0.8m wide). The left banner says”不忘明天是国家栋梁” and the right banner says”诸位今天是桃李芬芳”.
